import abc
from typing import ClassVar, LiteralString
from psycopg.sql import SQL
QUERY = SQL("SELECT {fields} FROM records WHERE id = ANY(%s)")
class Interface(abc.ABC):
    pass
class Rows(abc.ABC):
    pass
class Repository(Interface, Rows):
    FIELDS: ClassVar[LiteralString] = "id, name"
    def fetch(self, cursor, ids):
        cursor.execute(QUERY.format(fields=SQL("{fields}").format(fields=SQL(self.FIELDS))), (ids,))
